titulo_ja: できる と すき (3)

ように.es: para que; de forma que (con なりました)

なりました.es: llegó a ser; se ha convertido

はなせる.es: poder hablar (forma de poder de はなす)
はなせる.en: To be able to speak (form of power)

たべてみます.consejo: It says that something is being tested.

texto: To say that you have come to do something, I verb in the form of a dictionary or power + **ように なりました**: **はなせる ように なりました** (I could speak).
It describes a change that has already happened.

bloques.titulo: In this case, the Commission is not in a position to take action to ensure that the Commission is able to take action.
texto: To say that you strive to do something like habit: verb in the form of a dictionary + **ように して います**: **はやく おきる ように して います** (I try to get up soon).
It describes an effort that is maintained in time.
Form: + **みます** expresses that you try something to see how: **あたらしい りょうり を たべてみます** (I will try the new dish). It doesn't mean just «see» with the eyes.
